description:
Combined evaluation of Aiven for ClickHouse, DoubleCloud Managed ClickHouse, and OVHcloud Managed ClickHouse. Same questions as ch-altinity-spike per vendor: endpoint, auth model, SELECT version() output, DDL/DML deviation from open-source ClickHouse, trial cost, and TLS/allowlist behavior (DoubleCloud IP allowlist default-on is a setup note). Self-serve trials only; no sales-led engagement.

DECISION GATE: per-vendor go/no-go recorded in this item. A vendor that fails (no trial access, protocol deviation, prohibitive cost) is parked with its reason, not retried silently.

Guardrails: trial credentials in env only; SF 0.01 probe tables max; read-only recon where possible.
